# The uTop files for people: test fixtures

`alerts.yaml` and `templates/en.yaml` are a copy of the uTop sample's `config/alerts.yaml` and
`config/templates/en.yaml` in the backlog repo,
`docs/bl-refactor/presentations/tutorial/utop-backlog/config/` (F-140 D1). The tests read this
copy, not the backlog repo, as they do for `flows/`. When the source changes, copy the files
again.
